articles.title: ECU Programmers
articles.description: What Are ECU Programmers?ECU programmer is a connection device between the laptop and the car's ECU, which is used for "Reading and Writing" of ECU's memory in.
articles.bodyHtml:
What Are ECU Programmers?

ECU programmer is a connection device between the laptop and the carâ€™s ECU, which is used for â€œReading and Writingâ€ of ECUâ€™s memory in different methods. Depending on the type of the car or ECU, the Method of Reading or Writing of the file can be different. ECU programmers or ECU remapping tools have a wide variety of models, depending on the type of the job you want to perform and the type of the cars and ECUs. Because many vehicles have the ability to program through a diagnostic socket or OBD II, but in some others, the programming process is done as a direct connection to the microprocessor or flash. This method is called bench ECU programming mode or Reflash.
There are totally two ways for programming an ECU:

  1. Programming via OBD ll port (OBD mode): Which in this case, you can get the job done without removing the ECU from the vehicle.
  2. Bench ECU Programming (Bench mode): In this way, you need to remove the ECU from the car and connect to the board, and the plug on the back of the ECU. You usually have to connect up a few lives and earths to power the ECU up, and two can bus connections for programming.

There are a limited number of tools that are specialized for ECU programming. Based on our experiences and the researches that we have done on the users, we will tell you which one is better. Actually, we do not intend to promote a specific brand, our guidance is based on the technical characteristics of these tools, their strengths and weaknesses and their proficiency. So that you can choose the best tool, based on your needs.

AlienTech Tools:

1. KESS V2:

This is a tuning tool from the reputable Alientech company, with a long history in ChipTuning tools of cars, trucks, agricultural machinery, various motorbikes, and jet skis.
This programmer has the features of reading, writing, and programming the ECU file using the OBD II port. Thing to notice is, you can only read the ECU via OBD II port by Kess V2 and you can not program the ECUs that need to be opened. This programmer comes with a series of cables, connectors and converters which are designed for a number of special ports such as old BMWs or a generation of Honda and Nissan.

Advantages and disadvantages of KESS V2:

  • The licenses and drivers associated with this programmer are regularly updated, meaning that it supports more vehicle models each time it is updated.
  • large database and its support team.
  • However, since it operates online, the operation speed is sometimes low.
  • This device is user-friendly and guides you through all steps to safely read and copy-paste files on the ECU or TCU.
  • This device can also check the voltage of the battery when the car is ON.
  • Automatically checksum correction.
  • A good read and write speed.
  • ECU recovery when it is broken.
  • Integration with ECM Titanium.
  • Online updates.
  • Possibility to read and write based on different brands, protocols, ECU types, etc. and ensuring that the protocols are completely safe and test-approved.

As we mentioned earlier, Alientech has a large database enabling users to access various Original ECU File online for the following reasons:

  1. For downloading and using ECM Titanium Software.
  2. For downloading the original recovery file and restoring a broken or Un-programmed ECU.
  3. In order to read the file on some ECUs, the ECU case needs to be opened. Alientech company has made it easy so that you can download the file you want from their database using your vehicle chassis number and the ECU technical code, and then remap and write on the ECU using the OBD port.

One of the weaknesses of this device is that customer support takes a long time to be completed. However, we can say that it is one of the bestselling and complete programmers in the market, suggested to those who want to enter this professional business.

Also, the newest programmer of AlienTech company is KESS3. If you want to have complete information about it, you can read the article "What is KESS3?".

K-TAG Advanced Complementary Programmer for KESS V2:

In some specific vehicles and newer ECUs, it is not possible to program the ECU via OBD II port by KESS V2. that used for reading and writing EEPROM and flash on all of the on-the-bench ECUs. This means that in some cars you have to open the ECU from the car and do the programming on the bench. This device Comes with various cables; The power supply and adapter which you can use based on different protocols for different kinds of ECUâ€™s.
In order to program the ECU, Donâ€™t worry about soldiering on the board, since the â€œProbsâ€ adapters reduce the need for soldering and ease the task. By using these tools, you can read the ECU by different methods using the simple step-by-step guides explained in the software. The KESS and K-TAG use unit software and you can choose the connecting protocol based on your needs.
Since the K-TAG can read the ECU with a full backup in addition to the restore option, the possibility of a â€œdeadâ€ ECU becomes zero. You can also select to â€œUnprotectâ€ the ECUs that have tuning protection via OBD and by flashing the KESS. Alientech company updates its software every day, therefore by running the software, it automatically updates. Both KESS and K-TAG devices are available in master and slave version. It is good to know that most programming tools are available in both master and slave versions.

In order to have a better understanding of the differences between KESS V2 and K-TAG, we will compare them.

  • Both devices are identical in appearance
  • Programmable machines are also the same on both devices.
  • Both are the same in terms of functionality and software.
  • Both have the ability to read and write the ECU.
  • The master device reads an open and unencrypted file which provides the ability for you to make changes. But the slave device reads a locked and coded file which the user can not make any change or even open it.
  • The slave device must be linked to the master device.
  • In the master device, you can download or buy ramped files from different tuners. But in the slave device, you can only download from your master device, and you can not even download files from another master devices.
  • You can change your master and link to another client, but you should know that your current master must give you the permission. Which sometimes there is a risk that they will not allow you!
  • You can upgrade your slave device to master version, which in most cases masters do not tell you. In the following, we will teach you how to turn your slave device into a master one with training and support.

It is good to know that you can receive the device separately and activate different modules depending on the type of business you have. For example, if you work on trucks, there is no need to activate the modules related to the bikes and pay for them. Remember that these tools have annual subscriptions.

If you want to buy a programmer, contact us 058 579 6760

2. Dimsport Programmer:

The Dimsport Programmer is made by an Italian company. It is one of the best devices for commercials and Trucks. It includes three main devices:

My Genius Tool:

This is a programmer that can be connected to the vehicle by the OBD port and will connect only to a specific vehicle that is owned by the owner. It uses a specified serial number to interact with the ECU.
Because this device is made for owners to use, they have designed it as a standalone device that does not require any interfaces or software for programming. This means that you do not need to use a laptop or install any software to use this device. You can connect it directly to the OBD port and after turning it on, the device will take you step by step to complete the programming steps. Remember to take the warnings that it gives you during the process seriously.
This versatile console enables the user to save and program 10 different files for a vehicle. It is specially built for the owner that desires to use various tuning programs on their vehicle, and not suitable for the ones who want to establish an ECU remapping business for themselves.

New Genius Touch & Map:

This device is the more advanced model of Genius that uses an OBD port and does not require a laptop to connect to an ECU. It also guides you through all the steps to make sure you easily read the ECU program and reprogram it when needed. Furthermore, this device supports a wide range of vehicles for programming via OBD II port which is its biggest advantage in the market. It can be said that this is the only programmer that does not need a computer or laptop to program the ECU, and this option is its strong point since a USB cable, software, or sudden flattening of laptop battery power source does not damage an ECU, making the process completely safe.
The possibility of ECU errors is significantly reduced because of simple and well-explained steps. The device automatically checks the size and checksum of the file before programming and in case of an anomaly of the ECU program, the original file can be recovered. The device can reset all the errors that appear at the end of the programming.

New Trasdata:

Most of the new ECUs have an anti-tuning system, which prevents the user from reading and programming the ECU using OBD ports of devices such as New Genius. In this case, ECU data can be read using BDM, BOOT, JTAG, NBD, BAM, and GPT mode. Meaning that in order to read the microprocessor, Flash EEPROM, and Serial EEPROM, on-the-bench methods must be used. All the readable and writable ECUs that cannot connect to the OBD port can be programmed using the Trasdata programmer. In fact, New Trasdata does the same thing as K-TAG.

Simple operation is one of the pros of this device. You can detach the ECU from the vehicle, connect the device to the ECU using the instruction files, then by using the Flash Point software installed on your PC, you can read the ECU files. After that, you can tune the file youâ€™ve read in Race Evo or other software or even send the file for us so we can define the changes you need and send the final file for you. This device also supports autonomous checksum recalculation that enables the engine to work properly after tuning. Then, using the Trasdata to unlock the OBD II communication you can program the final tuning file onto the ECU using the OBD II port of the New Genius device. Connections can be done without the need for physical soldering and desoldering using a metal positioning frame provided with specific terminal adapters, which can be regarded as a valuable feature of this device. It should be noted that the quality of this device is superior to other competitors.

3. Autotuner Automotive Tool:

It is one of the best ECU flasher tools without a subscription. This programmer can support thousands of ECUs using OBD diagnostic sockets or support various microprocessors in boot tricore Infineon (BSL). This programmer can quickly read DFlash, Eflash, and EEPROM files of Bosch advanced ECUs that have an anti-tuning system, thanks to its Cortex m3 Processor. As an illustration, the Bosch EDC17C41 reads three times faster than its competitors. Another plus point of this programmer is that it is being supported by VAG, Mercedes Benz, BMW, etc. hence, most of the new F and G series of BMW and Porsche â€œBosch MG1CP007 & Bosch MG1CS047â€ ECUs can be read and programmed using the OBD II port. It can read and write the TCU (ZF 8HPxx Gearboxes) via the diagnosis port in the F and G series of BMWs. As positive points we can refer to the data logging capability. This feature is very effective for professional and accurate tuners. This is Because with accurate data analysis, they can perform the tuning in the best possible way and very accurately.
Reading and deletion of Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) that are generic and manufacturer-specific via the OBD II socket. One of the drawbacks of this programmer is that the EPROM occasionally does not read some ECU models and the Flash file is read in calibrated format, meaning that the file is not read in â€œBackupâ€ form. Therefore, when you open the file for remapping in software, the tables and parameters selection will be wrong, since the remap and map pack software are made based on the full dump address. Another problem with this programmer is that it does not support the older generations of ECUâ€™s and also the Chinese cars.

4. bFlash/ BC Consulting Programmer:

This programmer supports fewer ECUs nearly 400 types and is suitable for businesses that plan to tune chips and remaps for European cars. In addition to reading and programming ECUs, this device is a diagnostic scanner, data logger, CAN bus analyzer, and visualizer for WinOLS which makes it far beyond a programmer.
This programmer has advanced hardware capable of safely reading and writing at a fast speed, which is due to the NXP MPC57xx Microcontroller. Also, it has a user-friendly interface and provides regular updates and the annual subscription fee must be paid in order to receive the newest updates and protocols.
From a point of hardware, both Slave and Master versions are the same. The slave version of this device has a unique feature, enabling it to connect to multiple Master versions if all the Master versions agree for connection. As an instance, if you are working with a BMW remap expert, it can give you the permission to receive a Mercedes Benz file from another Master device. This feature helps you to connect to another Master if your current Master becomes unavailable.
Generally, the advantages of this device are the capability to read and write Siemens SIMOS, Bosch MED17, Bosch EDC17, and EDC16 ECU series. bFlash used to be one of the first programmers to read and program cars such as the McLaren 720, Ferrari 488 Pista, and Civic Type R FK8. In 2015, the company added the read and write option of Siemens SIMOS ECUs to the device.

5. MagicMotorsport Programmer:

Magpro 2 and Magic-motorsport flex are two of the best tools in the field of car mechatronics. This device supports ECU clones and Immo keys. Various car control unit programming such as TCU are included in this device, which makes it very handy. You can program or upgrade various advanced ECUs such as Bosch MEDC17 with different micros namely Infineon TC17xx, Nexus MPC5XXX, AUD for NEC 76F00xx, and so on using JTAG, Bootloader, OBD & Bench BDM, and other protocols.

6. CMD FLASH/ FLASHTEC:

This programmer is made in Sweden, but previously it was being built in Italy and the manufacturer used to work in Dimsport. This programmer is suitable for European cars, especially for BMWs and Audis. CMD Flash was one of the first companies to ever read and program the Infineon MPC555 processors such as the Bosch EDC16 using the OBD II, making it useful for almost all European and Korean diesel vehicles. It allows ECU protocol programming via OBD connector, using BDM and in Boot and Bench mode. The CMD is released in two versions, Master and Slave. The Slave version can only program the tuning file using the Master tool but comes at a cheaper price. This version is suitable and safe for diesel engine ECUs. Other pluses are automatic checksum correction, Recovery function, constant protocol updates, and CMD Flash- WinOLS Connector.
This programmer can read the EEPROMs of various ECUs. In case of an error or corrupted file during the programming, the ECU can easily be reprogrammed and restored.
The drawback of this device is the unsatisfying software environment, and not the best customer support compared to Dimsport and Alientech.

7. FG Tech:

Made by FG Technology, this device should be used carefully by amateurs that donâ€™t have enough experience in programming. The Dimsport and Alientech programming software are designed carefully to alert the user in case of an error in choosing the wrong connection or the protocol, however, the FG Tech software is not smart and User-friendly, and lacks strong instruction notes, unlike Dimsport or Alientech.
This programmer supports a wide range of ECUs. The final version Full-mode Tricore Extension enables the user to read and write Flash and EEPROM of Bosch EDC/ MED17 ECUs without having to open the ECU case by Pin out. All programming tasks can be done using OBD, On-the-bench, In boot mode, and BDM/ Jtag using a single device. It is necessary to connect to the internet during the writing process.
It should be noted that in case you faced an error during programming and needed assistance, youâ€™d be disappointed!
The positive point of this device can be considered its price, which is almost half of the price of the other devices in the market.

What is ECU Tuning?

Generally, the term of ECU can be confusing as it can stand for the â€œElectronic Control Unitâ€ and the â€œEngine Control Unitâ€. This article specifically refers to ECU as the â€œEngine Control Unitâ€.
In simple terms, ECU is in charge of monitoring and regulating engine functions. In modern cars, ECU has two aspects: software and hardware. And in ECU modification, changes can be made only to ECU software. What do these changes do? They can help reduce your fuel costs and improve your engine's power and torque performance. As you may know, the technical term for making any changes in ECU software is ECU Remapping (some prefer â€œTuningâ€ Though).

But, what is ECU Tuning exactly?

ECU tuning means adjusting and modifying the original ECU file towards a specific goal. However, in most cases, the purpose of making these changes is to achieve more power and torque, eliminate error codes, or make changes to delete AdBlue, DPF, EGR and etc.

Using ECU programming tools, you can read and write programs on the ECU. Then, with the use of tuning software, you can make necessary and desired settings on the ECU.

There are three general methods for reading an ECU file: reading the file through the OBD port, bench mode, and boot mode. To understand how each of these three methods works, you can read the article Remapping Knowledge.

For a better understanding and more information about ECU tuning, we will discuss the advantages of ECU remapping in the continuation of this article.

Also, if you want to learn more about ECU remapping, read â€œWhat is ECU Remapping?â€

The Pros of ECU Tuning:

1- Power and Torque Improvement:

Automobile manufacturers, regardless of their percentage of market share, must meet certain standards and consider various factors in their productions. These factors include, but are not limited to, AEL (Average Engine Lifespan), fuel consumption, automotive emissions controlling standards, relevant environmental issues, local and federal driving regulations, customer needs and satisfaction, and so on.
Now, since car manufacturers cannot meet every single of these standards and factors in the design of an optimal engine, ECU modifications can play a vital role in improving the engine's overall torque and power.
Now, introducing the magic of CaracalTech! With the help of the splendid Bosch MED 17.7.2 ECU in Mercedes C-Class C63 S AMG that already makes an amazing 502 horsepower, CaracalTech provides a totally safe extra 60 horsepower and more than 100 lb.ft of torque. You might wonder, isn't that too much customization? Is it really safe? No worries! This is a perfectly safe custom map for Bosch MED 17.7.2 ECU and it won't damage the engine at all.

To put all the points we have mentioned so far in a nutshell, ECU map modification or tuning gives us more power and torque and improves the overall performance.

2- Fuel Consumption Efficiency:

Let us be honest! When was the last time you were NOT worried about your monthly payment for fuel? We suppose never! we can help you get rid of all such concerns by offering its ECU remapping services. Can ECU remapping reduce my fuel consumption? To answer that question, let's see what ECU modification has anything to do with fuel consumption and see if we can drive frugally and powerfully at the same time.
The ECU software consists of different situation-specific maps that help ECU, for instance, control fuel and ignition in different working scenarios.
Let's imagine some real driving conditions. Assume you are stopped at a red light or have engaged the cruise control or are stuck in traffic. Under such conditions, that extra power or torque is unnecessary, and what we do is reduce fuel consumption by adjusting fuel and AFR.
Also, fuel and ignition are adjustable for best performance (torque and power) in cases with high rpm and load. We can remap the fuel/ignition tables in the ECU to ensure a cost-effective performance boost. ECU remapping gives you a 10-15% reduction in fuel consumption.

3- Enhance Throttle Response:

The big, inevitable disadvantage of using ETC or ''Electronic Throttle Control' technology is that it causes a delayed response.

In ETC-equipped vehicles, when the driver pushes the accelerator pedal, ETC sends a signal to ECU. Then the ECU digests the data and opens the throttle in accordance with the recorded tables inside its memory. This is a time-taking procedure and delays the acceleration response.
Now, why do car manufacturers bother to use ETC in the first place? Remember all the standards that manufacturers have to abide by that we talked about earlier? They are the main reason for the use of ETC technology. CaracalTech solution to we can improve throttle response with ECU remap and ChipTuning.
The picture below represents the relation between pedal positions and throttle position in different types. The picture depicts the impacts of ECU remapping on throttle opening. ECU remapping makes the throttle linear to improve the throttle response.

4-Speed Limiter Removal via ECU Remapping:

Cars are becoming safer and cleaner every year. Safety and environmental or road considerations may impose speed limits in various classes of cars.
Many modern cars are limited to certain speed levels. Given that driving may be an exciting hobby for some, they may want to remove this speed limit to participate in sports contests, for instance. This is where CaracalTech steps in to face the challenge.

5- Rev Limit Removal:

No matter what the ECU type, Bosch, Siemens, Delphi, etc., our team can identify rev limit. Through our online training or tuning file service, you will learn to identify, remove, or modify the rev limit.

Note: Keep in mind that increasing engine rev limit has no effect on increasing engine power and torque and is only used in special cases.

6- Removal of The Second O2 Sensor:

A second O2 sensor is installed after the catalyst convertor to monitor the efficiency of the catalyst that, if removed, causes the P0420 error code in the ECU, indicating a damaged second. You can rest assured with the ECU remapping service at CaracalTech since we help troubleshoot this issue so that the engine check lights are off again.

Note: This method is used when you have a headers or downpipe installed on the car and the car catalytic converter is removed.

7- Removal of The Diesel Particulate Filter:

In case you didn't know, DPF stands for â€œDiesel Particulates Filterâ€. DPF is a device (also you can call it a system) for pollution control. In a modern diesel engine, DPF is in charge of taking in soot and diesel particulates.
Once the DPF is saturated enough, it engages a regeneration cycle to burn off the particulate matter inside the filter. A DPF can be installed after and before the catalyst converter. The next picture shows a DPF installed after the convertor.
DPF has two chambers with one air chamber for a honeycomb air filter in a metal shell, like the catalyst convertor.
The diesel particulate filter has a particular pressure sensor at its inlet and outlet in charge of measuring the pressure data and sending them to the ECU.

DPF is mainly a measure for pollution prevention. our technician can Remove the DPF from ECU and solve this challenge, as in comparison to buying a new one, it's more economical to remove the DPF. So, if your DPF is not working the way it's supposed to or you have any problem with it, ask us for DPF Delete. We'll more than glad to help you.

8- Reducing Cooling Fan Temperature:

With ECU remapping we can change cooling fan working condition, we can define new temperature and active cooling fan sooner than manufacture setpoint to prevent damages in hot conditions

9- EGR off:

Contrary to the popular belief, EGR is not just about nitrogen recirculation as it stands for Exhaust Gas Recirculation. It is a gas reduction technique to reduce toxic gas emissions like nitrogen dioxide that has detrimental environmental impacts.
Like the rest of the systems in a car, EGR can also be damaged, requiring replacement. Unfortunately, EGR is expensive, but we can Remove the EGR from ECU using our remapping service. in some situation EGR off is for improving performance.

Needless to say, there are mandatory laws when it comes to EGR Delete. CaracalTech doesn't takes responsibility in this regard and it's you who have to abide by the rules depending on where you live.

Cons of ECU Tuning:

If remapping is done by professional individuals who have a proper understanding and good knowledge in this field, the remap will not have any specific faults. Otherwise, there is a possibility that non-professional and amateur tuners, by incorrectly adjusting areas of the ECU file, may harm the car engine. Another risk is tuning ECU on a car with mechanical issues. For example, a car with an oil leak cannot be fixed by remapping, nor can it improve performance! So, keep in mind never to remap a car with mechanical issues; first, address the problems and then proceed with the remap.

articles.description: AI Remap:Since artificial intelligence and related services have become pervasive (which actually has not been a long time), different uses have been made in.
articles.bodyHtml:
AI Remap:

Since artificial intelligence and related services have become pervasive (which actually has not been a long time), different uses have been made in various fields. Editing and creating images and videos, designing and ideating for different objects, writing different texts, and question and answer, and many other uses, including thousands of uses of artificial intelligence. In the meantime, many people have shown more creativity and with a little imagination, they have been able to find interesting and new uses for this new technology and combine it with various businesses and professions.

One of the professions and industries that we want to discuss the impact of artificial intelligence on is the automotive industry, specifically car remapping or ECU tuning. Currently, some automotive companies or other businesses related to cars and vehicles use basic artificial intelligence services such as chatbot question and answer and customer guidance (similar to a limited version of ChatGPT) services. The way these services usually work is that common questions and their predefined answers are given to these services, which then guide the customers. This service is very useful for websites that sell a large number of products.

But is that all?! So what are the more creative applications of artificial intelligence in the automotive and remapping industry? Are there other uses as well?

The answer is definitely yes, but to give a more precise answer, we need to explain a few very broad concepts in artificial intelligence in simple language.

What is machine learning?

What is Machine Learning? Machine Learning, or ML for short, is one of the subsets of artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence, in its simplest definition, is the integration of sciences to make machines more intelligent. Now, Machine Learning is a set of methods and techniques within the realm of artificial intelligence definitions. Within this, there is also a concept called Deep Learning. Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning (see below) and refers to methods and algorithms that help in the development of artificial intelligence by using and drawing inspiration from the neural network of humans and other living beings.

AI ECU TUNING; AI-CHIPTUNING:

Currently, automotive companies are offering very innovative designs using artificial intelligence. In fact, they modify and optimize some parts of their designs and calculations using artificial intelligence, personalizing the designs. In fact, this is the same work that is done in many other industries and professions (such as interior design).

But what is needed to make the designs offered by artificial intelligence more personalized, optimized, and practical? The answer: it requires more and more accurate data for machine learning. Now, keep in mind the point we made; the new question is: How can we use artificial intelligence for ECU tuning or remapping (we can even choose to call it "i-map"!)? Is such a thing possible?

Technically, yes. It is possible, and in an optimal scenario, this can have a low margin of error. We will explain how to reduce this margin of error for you in the following.

Currently, there is no company or service that provides AI remap (i-map) and the reason for this is that, according to the definitions we have mentioned, for a proper and very low or even zero error percentage i-map, we need machine learning. Integrating this framework with programming and also the science of remap requires significant time and a database of original ECU files. Given the relatively short public release time of artificial intelligence services, the necessary time to complete all the pieces of the AI remap puzzle has not yet been provided, and the existing cases, as explained above, are only pre-planned and ready dumps (such as the same frequently asked questions mentioned above). So if you are excited to use i-map, you need to wait a little longer and give time to this system for further and better development and lower error percentage.

Is AI Remap good?

If such a system is created by any company, as mentioned above, the important point is that this system should be based on accurate and fundamental information, maximum accurate information should be given to the system, and also supervision and double-check should be done by a technician (human supervision is necessary until this innovation reaches a safe point). If these conditions are met, you will actually be dealing with a regular remap and there will be no need to worry. In fact, it can be said that with the existence of i-map, we may even have more precise and less erroneous files, because if we review the reason for the need for such innovation with ourselves again, it reminds us that the whole reason for doing this, at least initially, is to get the job done faster. In fact, this means that a good i-map should be able to do the remap in the shortest time and then with the expansion of the system database and the machine learning process, other high-flying analyses and other strange and wonderful work can be done! So in summary, as good or bad as the remap is, the i-map is just as good or bad!

Stage Tuning with AI Remap:

Another question that arises is whether it is possible to do stage 2 and 3 tuning with this technology?

This is also possible with AI remap, but the issue is that completing the required data for stage 2 and 3 tuning requires more time and certainly more difficulty, as unlike stage 1 tuning in two similar cars (which can be a good exercise for machine learning), in stage 2 and 3 tuning, due to the use of aftermarket parts, this becomes more difficult because here the final files of two identical cars that have been staged 2 with different aftermarket parts will not necessarily be the same and there will be minor and major differences, in which case you cannot teach these two as a repeated file to artificial intelligence.

The Future of Tuners:

After the public release of artificial intelligence and related technologies, in many discussions, the disappearance of many jobs was predicted. Many predicted with great precision (in their own view) which jobs would disappear or become less prominent. But in our view, this is not the whole story. Such predictions with such precision require the examination of many parameters in various dimensions. We explain the issue with an example:

At the time of writing this article, there are many artificial intelligence services that do the same work that many engineers do. For example, in architecture, there are AI services that, with a photo of your house, provide you with very good 3D design proposals. But does this mean that all architects are going to be unemployed? No!

So does this mean that no danger threatens the job of architects? Again, no!

In fact, which professions and individuals are at risk with the expansion of artificial intelligence largely depends on themselves. The same example of architecture mentioned above requires an executor to implement the final design, address any final issues during execution, and have final oversight of the project implementation. But this is only in this specific profession. What we mean is that even if artificial intelligence enters many areas of human life (which it can), there will still be gaps and issues in implementation and before or after deployment that will require the intervention of a technician. Perhaps even without any issues, with the intervention of a technician and their collaboration with artificial intelligence, the final project may be of higher quality. What we mean by stating this is that with the entry of artificial intelligence, it is not necessary for someone to lose their job with certainty or to easily gain a specific advantage. In fact, this depends on individuals and how they utilize artificial intelligence. By generalizing the points mentioned to the profession of remapping, it can be said that the profession of tuners is not necessarily at risk with the entry of artificial intelligence, as the important factor will be how tuners align with this technology, which will either jeopardize their profession or advance their occupational and financial position.

articles.bodyHtml:
What You Will Read in This Article:

  • What is START/STOP system?
  • How does START/STOP system function?
  • What is the reason for eliminating START/STOP system?
  • What are Advantages and disadvantages of START/STOP system?
  • Software related to START/STOP DISABLE
  • START/STOP training

What is The START/STOP System?

Environmental issues and reduction of industrial pollution is a topic which has involved many scientists, engineers and companies globally. In order to reduce fuel consumption and consequently reduce emissions in the transportation and automobile industry, companies are examining and trying everything. From aerodynamic manipulations and weight reduction of vehicles, to electrification and making software changes.
Of course, legislation of various laws by government was not ineffective in these endeavors and among these laws, could be mentioned a law which has been legislated by the European Union and according to this law, the amount of CO2 emission would be 95 grams per kilometer for each vehicle from year the 2020.
One of the systems which has been designed and created for this purpose (emission reduction) is the SRART/STOP system. Observing the heavy daily traffic and long stops that the car make, sparked the idea of a START/STOP system in the minds of inventors.
The function of this system works in a way in which it shuts down the car in case of it having to stop for a long time, which results in preventing its useless operation and pollution.

How Does The START/STOP System Work?

In the previous part, we realized that START/STOP system turns off the engine in cases of long stops. When you put your car on the neutral mode and release the clutch, (in cars equipped with manual transmission), or when you press the brake pedal after putting it on neutral mode (in cars equipped with automatic gear and double clutched cars), you activate the SRART/STOP system. Indeed, the START/STOP system is designed in a way, in which it reacts to the reduction of the RPM.

But "how is this reaction to RPM reduction, and generally, how does the car becomes aware of it?" You might ask.
The answer to this question is that, in fact, the SRART/STOP system reacts to the information coming from the sensors of the car, and does the action (stopping the car). information coming from the sensor of the crankshaft and numbers of wheel speed sensor, with the awareness of the car put on neutral by the driver, helps the START/STOP system in doing what its required. In other words, information from the mentioned sensors, coordinates with the engine management system (EMS), and then with working with START/STOP system, comes the stop or restart of the car. But this isnâ€™t the whole story.Having a dynamic START/STOP system requires special changes and upgrades. Due to the multiple stops and starts that the SRART/STOP system imposes on the car engine and other components, it is necessary for certain parts of the car to be stronger than usual.for example it has been tried to use bearings that are several times longer in life than regular bearings in regular cars,for the cars equipped with START/STOP system.in these bearings,it has been tried to reduce the amount of friction as much as possible and to do the lubrication in the best way achievable. Besides the bearings, it has been tried to strengthen the starters of these cars because the engines of cars equipped with START/STOP system are started and stopped multiple times more than regular and as a result,the starters of these cars face extreme tensions and need reinforcement (being said that various companies have tried to use direct combustion in the engine for restart, thereby, reducing the starter tensions.Nevertheless, there is still much debate and conflict over the impact of these innovations). In addition, it is obvious that the batteries of cars that contain a START/STOP system should be stronger than the batteries of ordinary cars because the START/STOP system takes a lot of energy from the battery (information about voltage, temperature and battery charge can also be witnessed from the Electronic Battery Sensor (EBS).

In Here, it is Essential To Mention a Couple of Points About The Start/Stop System:

1. When stopping, the START/STOP system only turns off the engine and the other components of the car like ventilation system, power steering, audio system and other electronic components and systems continue to operate.

2. Some people mistakenly think that the start of the START/STOP system to restart is the same as the cold start of the car in the morning or after a period of inaction. There are fundamental differences between the two. In case of the start which happens in the morning, the car and its other components (as well as lubricants) are cold and can be harmful in some cases, but the starter that the start-up system makes to restart the car is not a cold start because the car components And the starters are hot.in fact, cars with START/STOP system also use the electric water pumps to maintain the desired engine temperature.

3. In case of ventilation system's need to restart (by any means), the engine will start again (regardless of any information that reaches the START/STOP system).

4. In sports cars that have dynamic and sport modes, by selecting them, the start-up system is automatically deactivated.

5. If the START/STOP system has turned off the engine, pressing the clutch pedal in vehicles equipped with manual transmission, as well as releasing the brake pedal and accelerating in vehicles with automatic transmission, will activate and restart the engine.

6. In cars with automatic transmission, if the car speed is reduced first and then the final stop is made using the handbrake, the engine will not turn off (the START/STOP system does not turn off the engine).

Well, so far so good! So why do some people think of eliminating the START/STOP system? We will answer this question in the part below.

What is The Reason for Eliminating START/STOP System?

The statistics claim that stopping sporadically in the vehicles in daily traffics is somewhere between 25 percent of driving cycle in Europe and 11 percent in United States. Other statistics claim that 14.8 billion liters of gasoline are wasted annually in the United States. Maybe if we add this statistic to the descriptions above, everything is in favor of the START/STOP system, but the issue is, unfortunately, not everything is always like what is claimed in the ads or mentioned in the stats.
The thing is, this system has significant problems. One of these problems is the depreciation that this system inflicts on the car engine. Although at the beginning of the text, we discussed boosting the battery, starter and some other components of cars that are equipped with a START/STOP system, but experience shows that these are not always enough. The high depreciation of this system cannot be ignored. These can cause some issues, such as vibration or noise in the car.
Another problem is the lack of START/STOP button on some cars. The START/STOP system is not a system that is required on all roads and driving modes, so if it is not possible to activate and deactivate this system manually, problems will arise for the car owner and driver.
All of the items above can be reasons why some drivers and car owners make the decision to eliminate this system.

If you have any question, feel free to contact us at: info@caracaltechmotors.com

What is Swirl Flap?

Swirl flaps are small metal valves knitted before the cylinder head intake in many modern engines. For the first time, they were installed on most BMW diesels in 2000, and ever since, they have been knitted to the engines of many vehicles, from Audi and Mazda to Mercedes and Vauxhall and other manufacturers. Engines equipped with swirl flaps have one flap per cylinder.

These flaps are made to enhance the combustion of fuel and air and to reduce emissions. Swirl flaps are made of stainless steel and are tightened into a spindle by two small TORX screws. You can easily see the O-ring and external actuating lever below the flap.

But how does the swirl flap work? We answer this question in the following lines.

How Does Swirl Flap Work?

Swirl flaps were designed to reduce emissions at low RPMs and improve the combustion of air and fuel.
What we know of fluid mechanics indicates when the intake air entering the cylinder is turbulent with a high Reynolds number, the air and fuel are combined more efficiently, resulting in enhanced combustion, which, in turn, leads to reduced emissions. For this to happen, the speed of intake air should be increased. To do this, closing these valves causes the inlet air to pass through a cylinder head port and loses its speed to the decreased cross-section.

At higher RPMs, the flaps open to supply more air needed for that specific engine RPM. In fact, at 2000 RPMs and higher, when the flaps are complexly open, the airflow faces no resistance and is normal.
In more modern vehicles and manifolds, a vacuum-actuated electrical servo mechanism controls the opening and closing of swirl flaps, keeping the flaps closed at the lower speeds and RPMs and opening them at higher RPMs (up to around 2000 RPMs), as mentioned above.

What is Swirl Flap Delete and Why?

Despite the modifications and modernizations on the first-generation swirl flaps, for instance, the one made by BMW in 2006, the design and functioning of swirl flaps stills faces many challenges: we mention some Swirl flaps symptoms below:

1) Deposits: Given the carbon in the EGR system and the oil in the vehicle's air intake system, carbon accumulation and sedimentation can reduce the size of the intake manifold and, even in some cases, cause the flaps to stick and get jammed at different positions and RPMs, which will turn on the check lights.

2) Mechanical problems: Swirl flaps, especially metal models, have many built-in mechanical flaws, such as the loosening of the metal screws holding the flap to the spindle. Failure and breakage of these screws can cause them to fall into the combustion chamber, which will cause very severe damage to your engine, causing you significant repair costs.

3) Manifolds leak: Sometimes, long-time intense use causes the swirls flaps' spindles to fail, leading to leaking. In fact, the leak is the compressed air exiting the inlet manifold, contradicting the design philosophy of swirl flaps in the first place. Besides, this failure disrupts the AFR and the failure of components, such as DPF and EGR.

The reasons mentioned thus far, and other reasons might make some owners think of removing the swirl of flaps. Swirl flaps can be removed manually, which will have some differences in the procedure depending on the vehicle type.

Swirl Flap Delete Pros and Cons:

One of the so-called commonly known advantages of swirl flaps is increased torque at low RPMs and reduced emissions. However, if you want the truth and the whole truth, you better know that reduced emissions can be, at a large scale (let us say, across the planet), an advantage. Still, you cannot see much of a performance boost with that tiny increase in torque at low RPMs to consider it an advantage! Based on this logic, the failures that occur to the swirl flaps, as stated above, cause EGR and DPF failure and increase emissions!
The disadvantages of swirl flaps, which we addressed above, include deposits, leaks, and mechanical problems.
Given what we discussed so far, you cannot really make a fuss about those drivers and repairmen's decision to remove swirl flaps.

Which Vehicles Have Swirl Flap?

There is a general list of engine models and vehicles with swirl flaps, such as these engines: M57, M47TU, 525d, E83, and BMWs. However, if you want to check if your car has swirl flaps, contact us so we can help. Moreover, depending on the vehicle, more specifically manifold and flap type, swirl flaps removal charges can vary.

Swirl Flap Removal Software:

As explained, swirl flaps are removed physically because these flaps have a direct and physical effect on the engine. But some owners prefer to remap their car after removing the flap, which although having nothing to do with removing swirl flaps, can boost your car's performance. You can also share this with our experts so they can guide you.

Swirl Flap Delete Remap Cost?

Swirl flap removal price differs from cars and in CaracalTech we can do it for you with the lowest price and we do our best with guarantee and support.

Here, you can learn once, fully and for good, the adjustments or removal of SWIRL FLAP in petrol and diesel engines. Below is a link to SWIRL FLAP training video in various software's and ECUs.

1- If you want to learn how to removal of swirl flap in Petrol and Diesel engines in WinOLS software, you can enter to our WinOLS Training Course.

articles.bodyHtml:
In this article, we have introduced the best cars for ECU Remapping. But what was the purpose of writing this article and how were the choices made?

Many of our customers, around the world, ask us this question: "Which is the best car for ECU tuning in our country?" They have a business goal for this question, which is the reason for writing this article. Our customers want to know which cars are more friendly for remapping so that they can develop their business by investing in advertising on these cars. Considering this point and the fact that our customers from all over the world ask us this question, we decided to answer these questions in the form of an article based on our experience in ECU tuning of various cars so that all our followers can see it and share their opinions with us.

But another question is, on what basis were the cars selected? Here we must mention a few points.

First of all, the cars we have chosen may not necessarily be the best cars for remapping in that country! Because our selection was cars that could be remapped even without using aftermarket parts and still achieve good numbers. So, there may be specific cars in each country that can undergo significant changes, but for the reasons we mentioned, these cars are not our focus.

Another point is that in this article, we have tried not to mention repetitive cars; in fact, each car is only listed once.

Also, please note that to be a bestseller of the chosen car in the respective country was also one of our selection parameters.

And as a final point, it is necessary to know that in cases like the Ford F-150, Golf, and other cars that have been produced for several years and have several generations, we have not made a distinction between different models because our goal was not to critique, review, or introduce cars. In this article, we have only mentioned the cars, their ECUs, and their engines.

1. Toyota RAV4 (Canada):

One of the most well-known compact crossover SUVs in Canada and also in the world, is the Toyota RAV4. The common ECUs for RAV4 are often found in the markets of Bosch and Denso. The 2-liter 143-horsepower engine is specific to Bosch markets, and Denso engines are also available in four engine sizes: 2, 2.2, 2.4, and 2.5 (in different â€œGENâ€ types) with engine codes such as 1AZ-FE, M20A-FKS, and A25A-FKS in the market.

2. Nissan Patrol (UAE):

One of the things that the United Arab Emirates is known for is the presence of super sports cars and expensive cars such as Bugatti, Ferrari, and Lamborghini. However, our chosen car for this country is the Nissan Patrol. Perhaps for off-road enthusiasts, the Nissan Patrol may be even more attractive than Ferrari and Lamborghini!

Three ECU brands, Bosch, Hitachi, and Motorola, have been used in various models of the Patrol, with engines of 3, 4, 4.5, 4.8, and 5 liters in this car (usually with the VK56VD engine code).

We strongly recommend to you the Stage 2 and 3 remap of this car.

3. Ford ó „€F Series (USA):

The popular and iconic F-150 series! No special explanation is needed!

The latest models of the F-150 available in the market (2024) include 8 types: XL, STX, XLT, TREMOR, LARIAT, KING RANCH, PLATINUM, and RAPTOR. The ECUs in these models also come from three brands: Bosch, Continental, and Ford. Ford's own ECU includes two types: EECV5 and EEC-V.

4. ISUZU D-MAX (Australia):

One of the most popular, best-selling, and remap friendliest pickup trucks in the Australian market is the Isuzu D-Max. After its Stage 1 remap, you will experience an increase of over 20% in torque and 15% in power.

In general, this vehicle has ECUs from 3 brands: Bosch, Transtron, and Delphi. The Bosch ECUs in this vehicle, which are usually from the MED and EDC series, come in 3 engine sizes: 1.5, 1.9, and 3 liters. articles.description: What You Will Read in This Article:What does "Linear Throttle Mapping" mean?Why is "Linear Throttle Mapping" done?Comparison between "Standard Throttle Mapping".
articles.bodyHtml:
What You Will Read in This Article:

  • What does "Linear Throttle Mapping" mean?
  • Why is â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€ done?
  • Comparison between â€œStandard Throttle Mappingâ€ and â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€
  • Software for â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€
  • â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€ Tutorial:

What Does â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€ Mean?

There are mainly two types of throttle valves in cars: mechanical throttle valve and electronic throttle valve (read more about it in TVA Removalarticle). If we want to speak in mathematical terms and graphs, the mechanical throttle valve has a linear graph (as shown below) because the ratio between the throttle valve angle and the engine load is constant and the graph has a constant slope. However, for electronic throttle valves (which are newer), this ratio is not constant and the graph of the throttle valve angle and the engine load is not linear (it is curvilinear). Now, the term "linear throttle mapping" is derived from this and refers to the linearization of the throttle valve angle and the engine load ratio (the word "linear" refers to this issue). In other words, in this method (similar to the mechanical throttle valve), the car accelerates directly with every pressure on the gas pedal.

Why is â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€ Done?

In many everyday driving situations, there is no need to extract maximum engine power, so it is necessary to control the engine power in different ways (including keeping the engine running in the unloaded state). One of these methods is the use of throttle valves. These throttle valves, with the help of a butterfly valve, control the intake air flow to the engine. In fact, it is the ECU that, with the help of sensors, gives commands to make changes in the air intake and also adjust the angle of the throttle valve. Therefore, we should know that electronic throttle valves have more limitations compared to mechanical throttle valves. Another point is that according to the principles of automatic control, electronic throttle valves have inherent delays (although minimal) compared to mechanical throttle valves.

Given these limitations and delays in the standard throttle mapping, there are drivers who are interested in removing these limitations and getting closer to the maximum power of their vehicles. Track drivers, highway drivers, long-distance drivers, and enthusiasts of power and speed fall into this category. These individuals come to us requesting the implementation of linear throttle mapping instead of standard throttle mapping in their vehicles.

Comparison Between â€œStandard Throttle Mappingâ€ and â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€:

In the previous section, we compared these two modes. In this section, we can briefly say that standard throttle mapping is probably a better option for everyday driving in urban areas and traffic. Standard throttle mapping helps your vehicle emit less pollution during traffic or lighter loads, and your fuel consumption will be relatively more optimal. Therefore, for this type of vehicle function, standard throttle mapping will be relatively more suitable, and the vehicle will perform more efficiently.

However, if your use of the vehicle goes beyond or differs from the previous mode, linear throttle mapping can be an attractive choice; No matter how much pressure you apply on the acceleration pedal, the vehicle will consume that amount of gas and produce power without hesitation or delay (or at least less than standard throttle mapping).

Software For â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€:

At CaracalTech Company, we have years of experience in calibration and ECU remapping. We have the ability to fully identify and modify the tables related to linear throttle mapping in all related ECUs. Here, reconfiguring the maps related to linear throttle mapping can be done using various techniques. Additionally, comprehensive training on the operation of both standard throttle mapping and linear throttle mapping in ECUs is available so that with just one proper training, you can identify and select the tables related to linear throttle mapping in EMS and make the necessary changes.

Additionally, in some vehicles, only â€œLINEAR THROTTLE MAPPINGâ€ is not sufficient, as DTCs may appear and further modifications may be required. However, we can solve this problem for you using diagnostic devices or ECU remapping so that â€œLINEAR THROTTLE MAPPINGâ€ is done properly and completely in your vehicle. Proper remapping alongside â€œLINEAR THROTTLE MAPPINGâ€ can display better performance from your vehicle.

â€œLinear Throttle Mappingâ€ Tutorial:

Here, you can learn the principles and tips for â€œLINEAR THROTTLE MAPPINGâ€ in different vehicles once and for all. HERE is the link to the tutorial video on â€œLINEAR THROTTLE MAPPINGâ€ in various Tuning Softwareand ECUs.

You can watch instructional videos ofECM Titanium Training and alsoWinOLS Training Course.

If necessary, you can upload your files inTuning File Service for us to make changes that you want in different ECUs.

articles.bodyHtml:
What you will Read in This Article:

  • What a Throttle Body is?
  • Throttle Body Types
  • Pros and Cons of Different Throttle Bodies
  • What is TVA?
  • Why â€œTVA Removal Moduleâ€ is Done?
  • TVA Removal Software
  • TVA Removal Tutorial

What a Throttle Body is?

In an internal combustion engine, the throttle body is responsible for adjusting the torque and power output of the vehicle. The Throttle body does so by controlling the amount of input air into the engine and adjusting the amount of fuel injection and other parameters accordingly. The throttle body is also responsible for keeping the engine ON, while the driver is not pushing the gas pedal.
In other words, we can say that the throttle body is a system that works in conjunction with other parts to perform its duty. The throttle body system is different from one vehicle model to another, depending on when the vehicle is produced. We will now discuss different types of throttle bodies to see how they perform and get familiar with their components.

Throttle Body Types:

Even though all throttle bodies have the same principle of operation, we can say that throttle bodies are separated into two groups:

  1. Mechanical
  2. Electronic

It should be noted that the mechanical model can be cabled or levered.

  • Mechanical Throttle Body:

These types are older than the electronic type and can be found mostly on classic cars. This relatively simple system is directly connected to the gas pedal.
The cabled mechanical throttle body is mostly used on fuel injection vehicles and it's newer than the levered one. In cabled throttle bodies, the angle of the throttle body is very important, since the ECU measures the amount of fuel injection and air to fuel ratio () based on this angle and other parameters (such as the air temperature and pressure which are calculated by separate sensors). This process is done using a potentiometer that is installed on the throttle body axis to measure the angle of the throttle body according to the transferred output voltage for the ECU. This is the part where two other sensors, the air temperature, and pressure sensors, come into play.

If due to any reason, the potentiometer failed to do its task, these two sensors can help the ECU to estimate the angle of the throttle body and control the fuel injection and air to fuel ratio accordingly.

These throttle bodies require a stepper motor (a servo-motor) to keep the engine on, while the gas pedal is not pushed. This is achieved using a bypass path that has been provided on the housing of the throttle body. It keeps the engine ON and controls the air volume that enters the engine. The stepper motor receives orders directly from the ECU and performs choking. The stepper is also obliged to open the airflow path when there is a demand for power from the engine and the engine is in low RPM to keep it still and stable.
Some throttle bodies are equipped with a heating element that keeps the throttle body warm enabling the stepper motor to work smoothly during the cold weather (without the O-rings being damaged).
Also while the car is moving, when the gas pedal is released, the stepper prevents the fuel and air mixture from becoming too rich and preventing lean combustion of fuel. As mentioned earlier, there is another type of throttle body that uses a physical lever, and it is older than the cabled ones. It can be found on classic vehicles.
These throttle bodies can be found on carburetor fuel systems. In this case, the throttle valve is a port of the carburetor. In other words, the throttle body is located at the entrance of the carburetor. At any angle that the throttle body is opened, fuel that is dripping from the jet nozzle will be sucked through while it is powdered and mixed with air.
In most carburetors, when the engine is running at low RPMs, a bypass air route is predefined which can be controlled via an electronic gate, adjustable screw, or even a vacuum valve control system. Some carburetors have an adjustable throttle body so that when the gas pedal is released, it leaves a small path of the throttle body open for air to pass.

  • Electronic Throttle Control:

The electronic throttle control system has the same working principle as the mechanical throttle body. This type of valve also has a servo motor similar to a stepper motor that, unlike the mechanical throttle bodies, does not need an auxiliary channel for lower RPM ranges, and all the process is controlled by the throttle control itself.
These throttle controls are under the control of the ECU. Same as the cabled model, the ECU uses a potentiometer and the information it generates to adjust the angle of the valve.
In other words, the whole operation of electronic throttle control is under the supervision of the ECU and it controls the process.

Pros and Cons of Different Throttle Bodies:

In this part, we would like to discuss the pros and cons of various throttle bodies.

The pros of electronic throttle control are:

  • Fewer failures compared to the mechanical version.
  • Fewer maintenance services compared to the mechanical version.
  • Less chance of stepper motor and sensor failure compared to the mechanical throttle body (leading to less excessive RPMs during idling).
  • Better adjustment of inlet air and the stoichiometricAFR.
  • Creates less pollution compared to mechanical throttle bodies.

The electronic throttle valve has its disadvantages.

The main one is the 1 to 2 seconds of delay during accelerating. The reason is simple; It always takes some time for the ECU to send and receive information. The time it takes to do so results in a delay before acceleration. It should also be noted that this problem does not occur in cabled mechanical throttle bodies and revving occurs without any delay in this model. This is why the cabled mechanical throttle bodies are more favorable in sports cars and competitions. From this viewpoint, we can say that the electronic throttle controls are suitable for city vehicles.
The delay related to the electronic throttle control could be partially reduced by remapping the vehicle; however, it would not be zero and the mechanical throttle body would still be dominant in this case.
Another advantage a mechanical throttle body has is that would cost less to repair and maintain if it broke due to more complexity of failure diagnosis and troubleshoot in electronic throttle controls.

What is TVA?

The TVA or Throttle Valve Actuator is one of the throttle bodyâ€™s components that is responsible for adjusting air during sudden changes in engine RPM. This system is used on diesel vehicles and it is becoming widely used on modern diesel engines.
Since the release of the gas pedal occurs suddenly and fast, the engine cannot respond to the changes at the same speed it happens. Therefore, the engine may start to vibrate. In this case, the air adjustment and management can help the engine to prevent the vibrations from occurring. This task is accomplished by the TVA.
Also, this system helps the EGR system to perform better.

Why The â€œTVA Removal Moduleâ€ is Done?

Our experience has shown that the TVA will face various problems in vehicles, such as the delay in reaching higher revs. This is why most owners decide to remove the TVA, and we organize the software removal methods for them.

TVA Removal Software:

We have years of experience in ECU remapping and calibration in the CaracalTech company and have the tools and tables for identifying TVA Removal for all ECU types. Adjusting the map changes related to TVA Removal can be done with different techniques. Additionally, TVA & TVA Removal in ECU tutorials have been prepared for customers to fundamentally learn and understand the tables related to the TVA Removal in the EMS and to choose which changes to apply, once and for all.

Note: In some vehicle models, TVA Removal is not sufficient, since it causes some error codes. We can solve this for you, using the diagnosis programmer or remap the ECU to correctly do the TVA Removal process. A genuine remapping combined with the TVA Removal can lead to a better performance of your vehicle.

articles.title: What is Spark Advance Table?
articles.description: Educational explanation of spark advance tables, ignition timing strategy, and how tuners should relate load, RPM, knock margin, and combustion quality.
articles.bodyHtml:
What is a Spark Advance Table?

A spark advance table is a set of values that tells the engine control module (ECM) when to fire the spark plug. These values are determined based on several factors, including the engine load, RPM, and engine temperature. By adjusting the spark timing based on these variables, the engine can be tuned for optimal performance and fuel efficiency.

How Does a Spark Advance Table Works?

In order to understand how a spark advance table works, it's important to first understand the concept of ignition timing. Ignition timing refers to the timing at which the spark plugs fires in relation to the position of the piston in the cylinder. Ideally, the spark plug should fire just before the piston reaches top dead center (TDC) on its compression stroke. The timing of the spark plug firing is controlled by the ECU. As the engine operates, the ECU continuously monitors various sensors to determine the engine load, RPM, and other variables. Based on this information, the ECU looks up the appropriate value in the spark advance table and adjusts the timing accordingly. For example, if the engine is under heavy load and operating at high RPM, the ECM might advance the ignition timing to improve power output. Conversely, if the engine is running at low RPM and light load, the ECU might retard the timing to improve fuel efficiency.

Identification of Spark Tables:

Identification of spark tables The easiest way to identify spark tables is to know their pattern as you can see above. In most spark tables, if we consider the horizontal axis as the engine load symbol and the vertical axis as the engine speed symbol. As the engine speed increases, the table values increase and as the engine load increases, the table values decrease.

Why ignition timing changes engine character so strongly

Spark advance is one of the clearest examples of why calibration work is more than fuel or boost alone. Ignition timing affects torque response, combustion efficiency, exhaust temperature, and knock sensitivity all at once. When the timing is well matched to load, RPM, fuel quality, and chamber conditions, the engine feels sharp and efficient. When the timing is too aggressive or too lazy, the engine can lose power, create heat, or rely heavily on knock correction.

That is why students should never treat the spark map as an isolated performance table. It belongs inside a wider conversation about load model, intake temperature, octane, and the feedback systems the ECU uses to protect the engine.

How tuners validate timing work in the real world

A practical ignition-timing workflow pairs map study with logging. The workshop should look at load, AFR or lambda, intake temperature, and any knock-related feedback the ECU provides. If the tune only looks good when the weather is cool or when the pull is unusually short, the spark strategy may still be too optimistic for normal use.

For educational content, this matters because it teaches the student what to respect: timing is where power, efficiency, and safety meet. A professional tuner shapes it carefully rather than using it as a shortcut to impressive dyno headlines.
